summary: fractal-ui keeps the last observed sidebar status visible but dimmed while a host reconnects, and lets a host own the transcript sync notice

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Only packages/fractal-ui changes. `SidebarStatus` exposes `data-observed-status` and `data-freshness` and dims stale observations; `Transcript` gains optional `syncPresentation` (default `inline`, unchanged). No protocol, harness or CLI change.
